gloss: get-well gift; a gift brought when visiting someone who is ill or hospitalized

definitions.gloss: get-well gift; a gift brought when visiting someone who is ill or hospitalized
definitions.explanation: The お prefix is standard and almost always included.

examples.japanese: お{見舞|みま}い{品|ひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I brought fruit as a get-well gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{見舞|みま}い{品|ひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What would be a good get-well gift for a hospital visit?

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉢植|はちう}え→鉢植え：15062_hachiue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{見舞|みま}い{品|ひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ふさわしく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Potted flowers are said to be inappropriate as get-well gifts.

notes:
A compound of ⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧ (visiting the sick/injured) and ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item/gift). The お is a polite prefix that is conventionally included and rarely dropped.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{見舞|みま}い{品|ひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧: to bring a get-well gift
- お{見舞|みま}い{品|ひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a get-well gift
- お{見舞|みま}い{品|ひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふさわしい: appropriate as a get-well gift

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, there are specific etiquette rules about what to give as お{見舞|みま}い{品|ひん}:
- Appropriate: fruit, flowers (cut, not potted), books, small treats
- Inappropriate: potted plants (⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ = "taking root" suggests a prolonged stay), items in sets of four ({四|し} sounds like ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧, death), strong-scented items
- Cash in an envelope (⟦{見舞金|みまいきん}→見舞金：24434_mimaikin⟧) is also common, especially among close relations
